title: Integrity Pack
description: A resource pack that aims to restore and uphold the artistic intent behind the original Minecraft textures.
body: Integrity is a resource pack designed to restore the original intentions and concepts behind Minecraft’s textures, while maintaining the more polished look of modern versions. Currently, the only updated block is Netherrack and its variants, as I believe its redesign strays the most from the original intent. If you have suggestions for other blocks that need similar reworks, please let me know!
